overall: MARGINAL this afternoon, GOOD in the north tonight; south still windy
limiterDetail: Main limiter: wind in the south plus afternoon showers in the north. Nangalao stays at 15.3–18 kt until Sun ~6 AM (peak ~8–9 PM), easing to ~11 kt Sun 8–9 AM. Cabunlawan and Decabaitot run 13.2–15.9 kt (peak ~8 PM). Ciron eases from 14.4 kt now to ~10 kt 7 PM–midnight, then rebuilds to 15–16.3 kt Sun ~3–6 AM. The north stays under 6 kt all 24h. Currents are mild (0.0–0.6 kt now). For the day as a whole ECMWF still rates Sat 17 GOOD (6.8 kt, gusts 15, ~6.2 mm).

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR of gale, tropical cyclone wind signal and heavy-rain alerts for Calamian / MIMAROPA. Latest MIMAROPA item is still GFA #4 (Final), Region 4-B , Sat 5:10 AM PHT (advisory ended).

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since this morning
items: Next week improved again, so shortage risk is back down from ELEVATED to MILD. ECMWF restored Mon 19 to GOOD (rain ~5.3 mm, was ~10.6; 4 kt, gusts 10), and it is now the week's best day. Four GOOD days in a row, Sat 17 to Tue 20 , so the model now flags a multi-area supply surge. Only Wed 21 to Fri 23 stay MARGINAL, and the worst day moved from Thu 22 to Wed 21 (9.3 kt, current 0.6 kt).

This afternoon: Coron, Culion and Galoc slipped from GOOD to MARGINAL on showers ~3–6 PM (about 1.2 mm/h); Maglalambay, Decabobo and Turda are GOOD instead. GFS shows much more rain right now than ECMWF (5.2 vs 0.6 mm), so the afternoon showers could be heavier than forecast. PAGASA is still CLEAR.

bestWindow.headline: ~6 PM–Sun 1 PM (Coron, Culion, Galoc, Maglalambay) · all day (Decabobo)
details: ~6 PM–Sun 1 PM: Coron, Culion and Galoc drop to 1.5–3.4 kt with 0.1–0.4 kt current, dry ~6 PM–midnight and only light drizzle (0.3–0.5 mm/h) after. The model's best hour is ~10 AM Sunday. Maglalambay is near-calm ~6–10 PM with 0.1–0.3 kt current; its best hour is ~6 PM.

Decabobo, all day: 1.3–5.9 kt wind, 0.0–0.4 kt current, nearly dry. Turda has the same wind but its current runs 0.8–1.0 kt ~6 PM–2 AM, so go now until ~5 PM or Sun ~3–8 AM. Tara's current is 0.8 kt or more for most of the next 24h.

Keep boats off Nangalao, Cabunlawan and Decabaitot until Sun morning (13–18 kt, gusts ~20–22, plus overnight rain). Ciron is workable ~7 PM–midnight (~10 kt; best hour ~10 PM) but rebuilds to 15–16 kt Sun 3–6 AM.
